delete.summary: Close and anonymize the current account
delete.description: Requires the current password. The operation is blocked while the account owns projects. On success, personal profile data and tokens are removed while the anonymized technical user row remains for generation and credit history. Limited to five attempts per user per hour.

get.summary: List significant screenplay characters missing from Character Studio
get.description: Analyzes persisted structured screenplay blocks on every request. A missing character is returned after at least six non-empty dialogue blocks, appearances in at least two scenes, or a match with an existing logical Character Studio record. A unique visible Character Studio record resolves a normalized name; draft records remain missing but satisfy the significance rule. Episodic and cameo roles are excluded.
